title: DEFTECH 2026 Submission Snapshot
historicalNotice: This historical record preserves the September 2026 submission evidence and capability boundaries. It does not inherit capabilities from later website or product updates.
thesis: Legal action selection does not by itself guarantee mission liveness.
definition: MEHWAR is a research-backed MVP for characterizing where autonomous navigation controllers lose mission progress and how those failures appear in trajectory evidence.

provenance.movementContract: 8-connected destination-cell-only, corner cutting allowed, orthogonal cost 1, diagonal cost sqrt(2)
provenance.verificationInterpretation: Implementation verification recorded for the frozen submission build. These are not safety scores or certification checks.

referenceLabel: deterministic A* reliability reference under the shared grid contract
selectionCaveat: Two selected development-validation scenarios illustrate the workflow. They are not a statistically representative benchmark or a fresh physically sealed holdout study.
referenceInterpretation: The point is not that one algorithm wins. The point is that legality alone did not expose the failure.

scenarios.interpretation: In this selected controlled scenario, zero invalid actions were recorded, yet the controller entered a legal two-cell recurrence and did not complete the mission.
scenarios.screenshotAlt: Original submission-era MEHWAR evaluator screenshot for C4-0001: mission not completed, two_cell_loop, 28 controller steps and zero invalid actions. The dashboard includes the trajectory, deterministic reference, diagnostics and interpretation boundaries.

scenarios.evidenceLabel: NO FAILURE OBSERVED IN SELECTED DEMO RUN
scenarios.interpretation: The same evaluation workflow also records successful mission completion.
scenarios.screenshotAlt: Original submission-era MEHWAR evaluator screenshot for C4-0000: mission completed, success, 16 controller steps and zero invalid actions. The dashboard includes the trajectory, deterministic reference, diagnostics and interpretation boundaries.

workflow.description: Versioned mission-liveness and failure semantics; invalid actions recorded separately
Deterministic A* reliability reference under the shared grid contract
Engineer-facing trajectories, JSON and human-readable reporting

demonstrates: Selected controller behavior can remain action-legal while losing mission liveness
Trajectories and diagnostics can be preserved reproducibly
Recurrence can be classified under explicit versioned semantics
Deterministic task-reference context can be provided under the shared movement contract
notEstablished: Safety certification or a collision-safety guarantee
External autonomy-stack, OEM or HIL validation
Customer validation, an existing pilot or product-market validation
teamStory: MEHWAR combines research/assurance ownership with product/integration ownership. The project grew from UAV dynamic-routing research and has already been translated into a functioning, reproducible evaluation workflow.
evidenceBoundary: Evidence is tied to the tested scenario, controller/configuration, evaluation semantics, and environment.
